verses.text_uthmani: حمٓ

translations.text: Ha Mim
Haa Meem

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

translations.text: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
Kasam hai is wazeh kitaab ki

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

translations.text: We have made it a Quran in Arabic so that you [people] may understand.
Ke humne isey arabi zubaan ka Quran banaya hai taa-ke tumlog isey samjho

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ

translations.text: It is truly exalted in the Source of Scripture kept with Us, and full of wisdom.
Aur dar haqeeqat yeh ummul kitaab mein sabt(transcribed) hai, hamare haan badi buland maratba aur hikmat se labrez kitaab

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ

translations.text: Should We ignore you and turn this revelation away from you because you are insolent people?
Ab kya hum tumse bezaar hokar yeh dars-e-naseehat tumhare yahan bhejna chodh dein sirf isliye tum hadd se guzare huey log ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: We have sent many a prophet to earlier people
Pehle guzri hui qaumon mein bhi baarha (baar baar) humne Nabi bheje hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

translations.text: and they mocked every one of them,
Kabhi aisa nahin hua ke koi Nabi unke haan (yahan) aaya ho aur unhon ne uska mazak na udaya ho

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

translations.text: so We have destroyed mightier people than [the disbelievers of Mecca] and their example has gone down in history.
Phir jo log insey badarja zyada taaqatwar thay unhein humne halak kardiya. Pichli qaumon ki misalien guzar chuki hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to say, ‘They were created by the Almighty, the All Knowing.’
Agar tum in logon se pucho ke zameen aur aasmaano ko kisne paida kiya hai to yeh khud kahenge ke inhein usi zabardast ilmi hasti ne paida kiya hai

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: It is He who smoothed out the earth for you and traced out routes on it for you to find your way,
Wahi na jisne tumhare liye is zameen ko gehwara (cradle) banaya aur ismein tumhari khatir raaste bana diye taa-ke tum apni manzil e maqsood ki raah paa sako

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ

translations.text: who sends water down from the sky in due measure––We resurrect dead land with it, and likewise you will be resurrected from the grave––
Jisne ek khaas miqdar mein aasman se paani utara aur uske zariye se murda (dead) zameen ko jila uthaya. Isi tarah ek roz tum zameen se baramad kiye jaogey

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ

translations.text: who created every kind of thing, who gave you ships and animals to ride on
Wahi jisne yeh tamaam jodey (pairs) paida kiye, aur jisne tumhare liye kashtiyon (ships) aur jaanwaron ko sawari banaya taa-ke tum unki pusht (backs) par chadho

verses.text_uthmani: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ

translations.text: so that you may remember your Lord’s grace when you are seated on them and say, ‘Glory be to Him who has given us control over this; we could not have done it by ourselves.

Aur jab unpar baitho (sit) to apne Rubb ka ehsan yaad karo aur kaho ke “paak hai woh jisne hamare liye in cheezon ko musakkhar(bas mein) kardiya warna hum unhein qaabu mein laane ki taaqat na rakhte thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ

translations.text: Truly it is to our Lord that we are returning.’
Aur ek roz humein apne Rubb ki taraf palatna hai”

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: Yet they assign some of His own servants to Him as offspring!Man is clearly ungrateful!
(Yeh sab kuch jaante aur maante huey bhi) in logon ne uske bandon (servants) mein se baaz ko uska juz (part) bana daala, haqeeqat yeh hai ke Insaan khula ehsan faramosh hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ

translations.text: Has He taken daughters for Himself and favoured you with sons?
Kya Allah ne apni makhlooq mein se apne liye betiyan intikhab (chose) ki aur tumhein beiton (sons) se nawaza

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ

translations.text: When one of them is given news of the birth of a daughter, such as he so readily ascribes to the Lord of Mercy, his face grows dark and he is filled with gloom-

Aur haal yeh hai ke jis aulad ko yeh log us khuda e Rehman ki taraf mansoob karte hain uski wiladat ka musda (tidings/news/khabar) jab khud in mein se kisi ko diya jata hai to uske mooh par siyahi(darkens) chaa jaati hai aur woh gham se bhar jaata hai

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ

translations.text: ‘Someone who is brought up amongst trinkets, who cannot put together a clear argument?’
Kya Allah ke hisse mein woh aulad aayi jo zewaron (ornaments) mein paali jaati hai aur behas o hujjat mein apna mudda puri tarah wazeh bhi nahin kar sakti

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ

translations.text: They consider the angels- God’s servants- to be female. Did they witness their creation? Their claim will be put on record and they will be questioned about it.
Unhon ne farishton ko, jo khuda e Rehman ke khaas banday hain, auratein karar de liya. Kya unke jism ki saakht inhon ne dekhi hai? Inki gawahi likh li jayegi aur inhein iske jawab-dahi karni hogi

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ

translations.text: They say, ‘If the Lord of Mercy had willed it, we would not have worshipped them,’ but they do not know that- they are only guessing-

Yeh kehte hain “agar khuda-e-Rehman chahta (ke hum unki ibadat na karein) to hum kabhi unko na poojte” yeh is maamle ki haqeeqat ko qatai nahin jaante, mehaz teer tukkay ladate hain (are simply conjecturing /guess work)

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ

translations.text: or have We perhaps given them a book before this one, to which they hold fast?
Kya humne issey pehle koi kitaab inko di thi jiski sanad [apne is malaika (farihste) parasti ke liye] yeh apne paas rakhte hon

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: No indeed! They say, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are guided by their footsteps.’
Nahin, balke yeh kehte hain ke humne apne baap dada ko ek tarike par paya hai aur hum unhi ke nakshe qadam par chal rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ

translations.text: When-ever We sent a messenger before you to warn a township, those corrupted by wealth said, in the same way, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are only following in their footsteps.’

Isi tarah tumse pehle jis basti mein bhi humne koi nazeer(darane wala) bheja, uske khaate peete logon ne yahi kaha ke humne apne baap dada ko ek tareeqe par paya hai aur hum unhi ke naqshe qadam ki pairwi kar rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: The messenger said, ‘Even though I bring you a truer religion than what you saw your fathers following?’ and they replied, ‘But we do not believe the message you bring.’

Har Nabi ne unsey poocha, kya tum usi dagar par cahle jaogey khwah mein us raaste se zyada saheeh raasta tumhein bataun jispar tumne apne baap dada ko paya? Unhon ne saare Rasoolon ko yahi jawab diya ke jis deen ki taraf bulane ke liye tum bheje gaye ho hum uske kaafir hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ

translations.text: We punished them: think about how those who rejected the Truth met their end.
Aakhir e kaar humne unki khabar le daali aur dekh lo ke jhutlane walon ka kya anjaam hua

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ

translations.text: Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘I renounce what you worship.
Yaad karo woh waqt jab Ibrahim ne apne baap aur apni qaum se kaha tha ke “tum jinki bandagi karte ho mera unsey koi taaq nahin

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ

translations.text: I worship only Him who created me, and it is He who will guide me,’
Mera talluq sirf ussey hai jisne mujhe paida kiya, wahi meri rehnumayi karega”

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.text: and he bequeathed these words to his descendants so that they might return [to God].
Aur Ibrahim yahi kalima apne peechey apni aulad mein chodh gaya taa-ke woh iski taraf ruju karein

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: I have let these people and their fathers enjoy long lives, and now I have given them the Truth and a messenger to make things clear-

(Is ke bawajood jab yeh log dusron ki bandagi karne lagey to maine inko mita nahin diya) balke main inhein aur inke baap dada ko mata-e-hayat (sustenance) deta raha yahan tak ke inke paas haqq, aur khol khol kar bayan karne wala Rasool aa gaya

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ

translations.text: yet when the Truth came to them, they said, ‘This is sorcery. We do not believe in it,’
Magar jab woh haqq inke paas aaya to inhon ne keh diya yeh to jaadu hai aur hum isko maanne se inkar karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ

translations.text: and they said, ‘Why was this Quran not sent down to a distinguished man, from either of the two cities?’
Kehte hain, yeh Quran dono sheharon ke baday aadmiyon mein se kisi par kyoun na nazil kiya gaya

verses.text_uthmani: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ

translations.text: Are they the ones who share out your Lord’s grace? We are the ones who give them their share of livelihood in this world and We have raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service: your Lord’s grace is better than anything they accumulate.

Kya tere Rubb ki rehmat yeh log takseem karte hain? Duniya ki zindagi mein inki guzar basar ke zaraye to humne inke darmiyan takseem kiye hain, Aur in mein se kuch logon ko kuch dusre logon par humne badarja-ha fauqiyat di hai taa-ke yeh ek dusre se khidmat lein aur tere Rubb ki rehmat us daulat se zyada keemati hai jo (inke rahees) samait rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ

translations.text: If it were not that all mankind might have become a single nation [of disbelievers], We could have given all those who disbelieve in the Lord of Mercy houses with roofs of silver, sweeping staircases to ascend,

Agar yeh andesha na hota ke saare log ek hi tareeqe ke ho jayenge to hum khuda e Rehman se kufr karne walon ke gharon ki chatein (canopy), aur unki seedhiyan (ladders) jinse woh apne baala khaano par chadte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ

translations.text: massive gates, couches to sit on,
Aur unke darwaze , aur unke takhat jinpar woh takiye (pillows) laga kar baithte hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.text: and golden ornaments. All of these are mere enjoyments of this life; your Lord reserves the next life for those who take heed of Him.
Sab chandi aur soney (gold) ke banwa detay .Yeh to mehaz hayat e duniya ki mataah hain.Aur aakhirat tere Rubb ke haan sirf muttaqeen ke liye hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ

translations.text: We assign an evil one as a comrade for whoever turns away from the revelations of the Lord of Mercy:
Jo shaks Rehman ke zikar se tagaful (gaflat) barat-ta hai, hum ispar ek shaytan musallat kar detay hain aur woh uska rafiq ban jata hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: evil ones bar people from the right path, even though they may think they are well guided.
Yeh shayateen aisay logon ko raah e raast par aane se rokte hain, aur woh apni jagah yeh samajhte hain ke hum theek jaa rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ

translations.text: When such a person comes to Us, he will say [to his comrade], ‘If only you had been as far away from me as east is from west. What an evil comrade!’
Aakhir e kaar jab yeh shaks hamare haan pahuchega to apne shaytan se kahega “kaash mere aur tere darmiyan mashriq o magrib ka boadh (doori/ distance) hota, tu to badhtareen saathi nikla”

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ

translations.text: [It will be said to them], ‘You have done wrong. Having partners in punishment will not console you today.’
Us waqt in logon se kaha jayega ke jab tum zulm kar chuke to aaj yeh baat tumhare liye kuch bhi nafeh nahin hai ke tum aur tumahre shayateen azaab mein mushtarik hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

translations.text: Can you [Prophet] make the deaf hear? Or guide either the blind or those who are in gross error?
Ab kya aey Nabi tum behron (deaf) ko sunaoge? Ya andhon (blind) aur sareeh gumrahi mein padey huey logon ko raah dihoge

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ

translations.text: Either We shall take you away and punish them- indeed We will-
Ab to humein inko saza deni hai khwah tumhein duniya se utha lein

verses.text_uthmani: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ

translations.text: or We shall let you witness the punishment We threatened them with; We have full power over them.
Ya tumko aankhon se inka woh anjaam dikha dein jiska humne issey waada kiya hai. Humein inpar poori qudrat haasil hai

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

translations.text: Hold fast to what has been revealed to you- you truly are on the right path-
Tum bahar-haal us kitaab ko mazbooti se thamay raho jo wahi ke zariye se tumhare paas bheji gayi hai, yaqeenan tum seedhey raaste par ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

translations.text: for it is a reminder for you and your people: you will all be questioned.
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke yeh kitaab tumahre liye aur tumhari qaum ke liye ek bahut bada sharaf hai aur anqareeb tum logon ko iski jawab-dahi karni hogi

verses.text_uthmani: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ

translations.text: Ask the prophets We sent before you: ‘Did We ever appoint any gods to be worshipped besides the Lord of Mercy?’
Tumse pehle humne jitne Rasool bheje thay un sab se pooch dekho, kya humne khuda e Rehman ke siwa kuch dusre maabood bhi muqarrar kiye thay ke unki bandagi ki jaaye

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

translations.text: We sent Moses to Pharaoh and his courtiers and he said, ‘I am truly a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,’
Humne Moosa ko apni nishaniyon ke saath Firoun aur uske ayaan-e-sultanat ke paas bheja, aur usne jaa kar kaha ke main Rubb ul aalamin ka Rasool hoon

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ

translations.text: but when he presented Our signs to them, they laughed,
Phir jab usne hamari nishaniyan unke saamne pesh ki to woh thatte (laughter) maarne lagey

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

translations.text: even though each sign We showed them was greater than the previous one. We inflicted torment on them so that they might return to the right path.
Hum ek par ek aisi nishani unko dikhate chale gaye jo pehli se badh chadh kar thi, aur humne unko azaab mein dhar liya taa-ke woh apni rawish se baaz aayein

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ

translations.text: They said, ‘Sorcerer, call on your Lord for us, by virtue of His pledge to you: we shall certainly accept guidance,’
Har azaab ke mauqe par woh kehte, Aey saahir (Jaadugar/magician), apne Rubb ki taraf se jo mansab tujhe haasil hai uski bina par hamare liye ussey duaa kar, hum zaroor raah-e-raast par aa jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ

translations.text: but as soon as We relieved their torment they broke their word.
Magar joonh hi ke hum unpar se azaab hata detay woh apni baat se phir jaatey thay

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

translations.text: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, ‘My people, is the Kingdom of Egypt not mine? And these rivers that flow at my feet, are they not mine? Do you not see?

Ek roz Firoun ne apni qaum ke darmiyan pukar kar kaha, “logon, kya misr (egypt) ki baadshahi meri nahin hai, aur yeh nehrein (streams) mere nichey nahin beh rahi hain? Kya tum logon ko nazar nahin aata

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ

translations.text: Am I not better than this contemptible wretch who can scarcely express himself?
Mein behtar hoon ya yeh shaks jo zaleel o haqeer hai aur apni baat bhi khol kar bayan nahin kar sakta

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ

translations.text: Why has he not been given any gold bracelets? Why have no angels come to accompany him?’
Kyun na ispar soney (gold) ke kangan (bangles) utare gaye? Ya farishton ka ek dasta iski ardali mein na aaya?”

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

translations.text: In this way he moved his people to accept and they obeyed him- they were perverse people.
Usne apni qaum ko halka samjha aur unhon ne uski itaat ki, dar haqeeqat woh thay hi faasiq log

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

translations.text: When they provoked Us, We punished and drowned them all:
Aakhir e kaar jab unhon ne humein gazabnaak kardiya to humne unse inteqam liya aur unko ikattha garq (drown) kiya

verses.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

translations.text: We made them a lesson and an example for later people.
Aur baad walon ke liye pesh-ro aur namoona ibrat banakar rakh diya

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ

translations.text: When the son of Mary is cited as an example, your people [Prophet] laugh and jeer,
Aur jonhi ke ibne Maryam (Jesus) ki misal di gayi, tumhari qaum ke logon ne uspar gul macha diya (chilla utthey/ raised a clamour)

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ

translations.text: saying, ‘Are our gods better or him?’- they cite him only to challenge you: they are a contentious people-
Aur lagey kehne ke hamare maabood acche hain ya woh? Yeh misaal woh tumhare saamne mehaz kach-behasi (argument/ contentiousness) ke liye laaye hain, haqeeat yeh hai ke yeh hain hi jhagdalu log

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

translations.text: but he is only a servant We favoured and made an example for the Children of Israel:
Ibne Maryam (Jesus) iske siwa kuch na tha ek banda tha jispar humne inaam kiya aur bani israel ke liye apni qudrat ka ek namuna bana diya

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ

translations.text: if it had been Our will, We could have made you angels, succeeding one another on earth.
Hum chahein to tumse farishte paida kardein jo zameen mein tumhare janasheen(successors) hon

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

translations.text: This [Quran] gives knowledge of the Hour: do not doubt it. Follow Me for this is the right path;
Aur woh dar-asal qayamat ki ek nishani hai, pas tum usmein shakk na karo meri baat maan lo, yahi seedha raasta hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

translations.text: do not let Satan hinder you, for he is your sworn enemy.
Aisa na ho shaytan tumko ussey roak de ke woh tumhara khula dushman hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ

translations.text: When Jesus came with clear signs he said, ‘I have brought you wisdom; I have come to clear up some of your differences for you. Be mindful of God and obey me:

Aur jab Isa (Jesus) sareeh nishaniyan liye huey aaya tha to usne kaha tha ke “main tum logon ke paas hikmat lekar aaya hoon, aur isliye aaya hoon ke tumpar baaz un baaton ki haqeeqat khol doon jin mein tum ikhtilaf kar rahey ho, lihaza tum Allah se daro aur meri itaat karo

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

translations.text: God is my Lord and your Lord. Serve Him: this is the straight path.’
Haqeeqat yeh hai ke Allah hi mera Rubb bhi hai aur tumhara Rubb bhi.Usi ki tum ibadat karo, yahi seedha raasta hai”

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ

translations.text: Yet still the different factions among them disagreed- woe to the evildoers: they will suffer the torment of a grievous day!-
Magar (uski is saaf taleem ke bawajood) girohon (factions) ne aapas mein ikhtilaf kiya, pas tabahi hai un logon ke liye jinhon ne zulm kiya ek dardnaak din ke azaab se

verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ

translations.text: what are they waiting for but the Hour, which will come upon them suddenly and take them unawares?
Kya yeh log ab bas isi cheez ke muntazir hain ke achanak inpar qiyamat aa jaye aur inhein khabar bhi na ho

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ

translations.text: On that Day, friends will become each other’s enemies. Not so the righteous-
Woh din jab aayega to muttaqin ko chodh kar baaki sab dost ek dursre ke dushman ho jayenge

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ

translations.text: ‘My servants, there is no fear for you today, nor shall you grieve’––
Us roz un logon se jo hamari aayat par imaan laaye thay aur mutii-e-farmaan bankar rahey thay

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

translations.text: those who believed in Our revelations and devoted themselves to Us.
Kaha jayega ke “aey mere bandon (servents), aaj tumhare liye koi khauff nahin aur na tumhein koi gham lahiq hoga

verses.text_uthmani: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ

translations.text: ‘Enter Paradise, you and your spouses: you will be filled with joy.’
Dakhil ho jao jannat mein tum aur tumhari biwiyan, tumhein khush kardiya jaayega”

verses.text_uthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

translations.text: Dishes and goblets of gold will be passed around them with all that their souls desire and their eyes delight in. ‘There you will remain:

Unke aagay soonay (golden) ke thal (Platters) aur sagar gardish karaye jayenge aur har mann bhaati aur nigaahon ko lazzat dene wali cheez wahan maujood hogi. Unse kaha jayega, “tum ab yahan hamesha rahoge

verses.text_uthmani: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

translations.text: this is the Garden you are given as your own, because of what you used to do,
Tum is jannat ke waaris apne un aamal ki wajah se huey ho jo tum duniya mein karte rahe

verses.text_uthmani: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ

translations.text: and there is abundant fruit in it for you to eat.’
Tumhare liye yahan bakasrat fawake(abundant fruits) maujood hain jinhein tum khaogey”

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ

translations.text: But the evildoers will remain in Hell’s punishment,
Rahe mujreem , to woh hamesha jahannum ke azaab mein mubtala rahenge

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ

translations.text: from which there is no relief: they will remain in utter despair.
Kabhi unke azaab mein kami na hogi, aur woh us mein mayous padey hongey

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

translations.text: We never wronged them; they were the ones who did wrong.
Unpar humne zulm nahin kiya balke woh khud hi apne upar zulm karte rahey

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ

translations.text: They will cry, ‘Malik, if only your Lord would finish us off,’ but he will answer, ‘No! You are here to stay.’
Woh pukarenge, “aey maalik, tera Rubb hamara kaam hi tamam ka de to accha hai” woh jawab dega “tum yun hi padey rahogey

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ

translations.text: We have brought you the Truth but most of you despise it.
Hum tumhare paas haqq lekar aaye thay magar tum mein se aksar ko haqq hi nagawaar tha”

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ

translations.text: Have these disbelievers thought up some scheme? We too have been scheming.
Kya in logon ne koi iqdam (plot) karne ka faisla karliya hai? Accha to hum bhi phir ek faisla kiye letey hain

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ

translations.text: Do they think We cannot hear their secret talk and their private counsel? Yes we can: Our messengers are at their sides, recording everything.
Kya inhon ne yeh samajh rakkha hai ke hum inki raaz ki baatein aur inki sargoshiyan sunte nahin hain? Hum sab kuch sun rahey hain aur hamare farishtey inke paas hi likh rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ

translations.text: Say [Prophet], ‘If the Lord of Mercy [truly] had offspring I would be the first to worship [them], but-
Inse kaho, agar waqai Rehman ki koi aulad hoti to sabse pehle Ibadat karne wala main hota”

verses.text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

translations.text: exalted be the Lord of the heavens and earth, the Lord of the Throne- He is far above their false descriptions.’
Paak hai aasmaano aur zameen ka farma rawan, Arsh ka maalik, un saari baaton se jo yeh log us ki taraf mansoob karte hain

verses.text_uthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

translations.text: Leave them to wade in deeper and play about, until they face the Day they have been promised.
Accha, inhein apne baatil khayalat mein garq aur apne khel mein munhamik rehne do, yahan tak ke yeh apna woh din dekh lein jiska inhein khauff dilaya jaa raha hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

translations.text: It is He who is God in heaven and God on earth; He is the All Wise, the All Knowing;
Wahi ek aasman mein bhi khuda hai aur zameen mein bhi khuda, aur wahi hakeem o Aleem hai

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

translations.text: Exalted is He who has control of the heavens and earth and everything between them; He has knowledge of the Hour; you will all be returned to Him.

Bahut baala-o-bartar hai woh jiske qabze mein zameen aur aasmaano aur har us cheez ki baadshahi hai jo zameen o aasman ke darmiyan payi jaati hai. Aur wahi qayamat ki ghadi ka ilm rakhta hai, aur usi ki taraf tum sab paltaye jaane waale ho

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: Those gods they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, unlike those who bore witness to the truth and recognized it.
Usko chodh kar yeh log jinhein pukarte hain woh kisi shafaat ka ikhtiyar nahin rakhte, illa yeh ke koi ilm ki bina par haqq ki shahadat de

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ

translations.text: If you [Prophet] ask them who created them they are sure to say, ‘God,’ so why are they so deluded?
Aur agar tum insey pucho ke inhein kisne paida kiya hai to yeh khud kahenge ke Allah ne. Phir kahan se yeh dhoka kha rahe hain

verses.text_uthmani: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ

translations.text: The Prophet has said, ‘My Lord, truly these are people who do not believe,’
Kasam hai Rasool ke is qaul ki ke aey Rubb, yeh woh log hain jo maan kar nahin detay

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

translations.text: but turn away from them and say, ‘Peace’: they will come to know.
Accha, aey nabi insey darguzar karo aur kehdo ke salaam hai tumhein, anqareeb inhein maaloom ho jayega
